blurb: Situated in the heart of Rome, Georgia, our scenic and beautiful 9-hole, par 70 golf course was established in 1935 which makes it one of the oldest active golf course in NW Georgia. Our course is perfect for golfers of all skill levels, from beginners to seasoned pros.
